bg-app.description: Page and stage background behind everything.

bg-surface.description: Header bar, inspector panel, inner cards, dialogs.

bg-raised.description: Elements raised above a surface or a control track: the active segment, secondary buttons.

bg-floating.description: Floating layers: menus, popovers, floating toolbars.

bg-section.description: The well behind a section's card.

bg-inset.description: Small recessed controls: tilt pad, anchor grid.

bg-control.description: Segmented track, value badge, soft button, hover fill.

bg-control-active.description: Ghost trigger while its menu is open.

border-strong.description: Slider track, anchor grid, tilt pad, and the edge of a disabled input.

control-border.description: The edge that marks a control where nothing else does: a text input's box, a checkbox's box, a switch's track. 3:1 on every surface.

text.description: Labels, primary text, the active segment.

text-secondary.description: Section titles, body copy, value badges, icons, inactive segments.

text-disabled.description: Disabled text. Exempt from contrast rules, like all inactive UI.

text-disabled-subtle.description: Disabled chip text, one step quieter than text-disabled.

primary-hover.description: Primary hover. Lightens in light mode rather than darkening.

primary-disabled.description: Disabled primary background; the text keeps on-primary.

divider-on-primary.description: The hairline between a split button's halves.

inverse-text-secondary.description: Secondary text and actions in tooltips and toasts.

inverse-success.description: Success on the inverse surface: a success toast's icon. Each theme takes the other theme's success, which reads on its inverse surface.

inverse-warning.description: Warning on the inverse surface: a warning toast's icon.

inverse-danger.description: Danger on the inverse surface: a danger toast's icon.

inverse-success-bg.description: A success toast: the inverse surface mixed toward inverse-success in OKLab, 18% (14% in dark).

inverse-warning-bg.description: A warning toast: the inverse surface mixed toward inverse-warning, 18% (14% in dark).

inverse-danger-bg.description: A danger toast: the inverse surface mixed toward inverse-danger, 18% (14% in dark).

accent.description: Focus ring, tilt arc, selection highlights.

accent-text.description: The accent as text: links and icons in an info callout. 4.5:1 on the surface and on accent-subtle, even when a theme's accent is lighter.

chart-1.description: A chart's first series: the accent.

chart-2.description: A chart's second series: the mint family at the accent's OKLCH lightness, chroma 0.14 or the most sRGB allows.

chart-3.description: A chart's third series: the apricot family at the accent's OKLCH lightness, chroma 0.14 or the most sRGB allows.

chart-4.description: A chart's fourth series: the lilac family at the accent's OKLCH lightness, chroma 0.14.

chart-5.description: A chart's fifth series: the rose family at the accent's OKLCH lightness, chroma 0.14.

chart-muted.description: A comparison series, such as the previous period: the lightest gray still 3:1 on every chart background.

danger.description: Errors: a field's border and message, error icons.

success.description: Success text and icons, a met requirement.

wash.description: Wash over the blurred page behind a menu.

dot.description: Page dots and idle anchor dots.

ring-selected.description: Selected swatch ring, crop handle border, drop-zone dashes.

knob-top.description: Top of the slider thumb's vertical gradient.

knob-bottom.description: Bottom of the slider thumb's vertical gradient.

knob-center.description: Lit point of the radial knob gradient (tilt knob, active anchor dot), 30% down from the top.

knob-edge.description: Where the radial knob gradient ends: the bottom edge, the side farthest from the lit point.

knob-highlight.description: One-pixel inset highlight along the top of a knob.

knob-grip.description: The two grip lines on the slider thumb.

knob-ring.description: The ring around a thumb drawn over picked colors (the color picker's), the same in both themes so it shows on any color.

brand-butter.description: buttery's brand color. Decorative only: the mark, docs, marketing.

brand-butter-deep.description: The brand mark's side and shadow.

brand-gloss.description: The brand mark's highlight, white on any background.

brand-shadow.description: The brand mark's contact shadow, drawn faint and blurred.

skeleton.description: A Skeleton's fill, and skeleton blocks in illustrations.

skeleton-strong.description: The band that sweeps across a Skeleton, and skeleton lines in illustrations.

shadow-card.description: Header bar, inspector panel, inner card. The 1px ring is the card's edge.

shadow-raised.description: Active segment, secondary button, hovered card.

shadow-selected.description: The selected item's pill on a control track. In dark, a brighter edge than raised, because the pill's fill sits close to the track's.

ring-focus.description: Focus ring as a shadow, for components that can't use the outline ring.

sm.description: Small icon buttons, dialog close. Stays 28 in compact: standalone buttons are never shorter.

control.description: Segmented track (items are 4 shorter), inputs, selects.

button.description: Pill buttons, split button, header actions, menu items, toast.

row-split.description: Inspector split row: two half-rows side by side, tall enough for a tilt pad or an anchor grid, including its 1px divider.

nav-bar.description: Page nav bar. Page chrome, so it keeps its height in compact.

sub-nav.description: Page sub nav bar under the nav bar. Page chrome, so it keeps its height in compact.

table-row.description: Table header and body rows, including their 1px divider.

sidebar-rail.description: The sidebar as an icon rail.

app-page.description: A contained app page's content, padding included, centered in the content column.

app-page-md.description: A settings detail page's content, padding included.

app-page-sm.description: A dense form's or a preferences matrix's content, padding included.

search.description: The top bar's search field, at most.

search-open.description: The top bar's search field while it has focus, and its panel, at most.

side-panel.description: A side panel docked at the shell's end, or its sheet, at most.

side-panel-wide.description: A docked side panel once it's expanded.

dialog-md.description: A wider dialog, such as a list of choices.

dialog-lg.description: A two-column dialog, such as an announcement with copy beside an illustration.

row-control.description: Slider width in an inspector row.

prose.description: Long-form text at most, such as a docs page's prose; demos beside it may run wider.

nav-panel-min.description: The least a nav menu's panel shows below its bar in a short window; a taller menu scrolls inside it.

inset-titlebar.description: HeaderBar's left padding under the macOS window controls, from its own left edge.

focus-offset.description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

blur-scrim.description: Backdrop blur behind menus that open over content.

sans.value: "Inter Variable", "Inter Fallback", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

title-lg.description: App page titles and metric values.

title-md.description: Section headings in app pages, card titles in a right rail.

title-sm.description: App or document title in the header.

button.description: Pill buttons. Takes its color from the button.

button-lg.description: 48px CTA buttons. Takes its color from the button.

control.description: Segmented items, section titles, reset links.

heading-2.description: Sub-section and card headings on pages.
